notes: Old named forms became archetypes or versions (Abaniko, Akomeogi, Brisé, Cocarda→Cockade fan, Harisen, Hiōgi, Mai ogi, Tessen; Gunbai-uchiwa, Pamaypay, Pushan, Queshan, Screen fan, Tuanshan, Yushan, Bincana). Left out as ceremonial/liturgical, not sensibly owned: Flabellum, Rhipis (rhipidion), Wumingshan (imperial ceremonial fan) — note for F4 (religious/ceremonial objects). Battery/hand-cranked mechanical hand fans not added (portable climate, B7). Edo uchiwa kept only as a version: no page confirming a craft designation was retrieved. Wikipedia 'Uchiwa' URL resolves to Hand fan, so uchiwa cites the Ibasen tradition page. No authenticity markers found for Kyō-sensu, Valencia or Hangzhou.
